_doc: IC v2 detector config — Apr 30 2026. Replaces the v1 AND-gate (ADX<22 + BB-squeeze + RV/IV<0.80) which fired 0/2590 valid samples on Indian post-SEBI data because its three conditions are negatively correlated. The v2 gate uses two ORTHOGONAL literature-canonical signals: Choppiness Index >= 61.8 (Bill Dreiss, Fibonacci threshold from technical-analysis canon) AND VRP > 0 (Bollerslev-Tauchen-Zhou 2009 textbook break-even from academic finance). Both thresholds are STANDARD LITERATURE, not tuned. All other IC params at defaults — only the new gate flips on. Per user direction: don't curve-fit; use proven indicators with standard thresholds.
